name: Finality's Auger

frame.name: Ruinscribe's Forge
frame.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  to fire a special projectile that deploys a Ruinscribe Turret. This projectile costs 3 ammo to fire. Aim the projectile skyward to provide the clearest sight lines for the turret which will automatically shoot at nearby targets.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Ruinscribe's Beacon
perks.description: While a Ruinscribe Turret is deployed, this weapon can paint targets with its laser projectiles. The turret prioritizes painted targets and fires more powerful munitions at them. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap between normal fire and laser fire modes.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: Write the future into the present.

catalyst.name: Finality's Auger Catalyst
catalyst.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.
